textSnippet: DONNELLY, Patrick Hugh: Death : Irish Times The Irish Times My Account --> Subscribe Sign In --> Family Notices Irish Times Family Notices Recent Notices Book a notice Sign in Notice Condolences DONNELLY, Patrick Hugh: Death Death 560 --> Published on the Irish Times website on 20th October 2024 DONNELLY, Patrick Hugh Died peacefully at home on 17th October 2024. Beloved son of the late John and Vera, devoted husband of Anna, much loved father of Aisling, Ronan, Killian and Dervla. Dear father-in-law of Niall, Parul, Fiona and Richard. Cherished grandfather to Freya, Tom, Elijah, Kian, Mira, Oisín and Fionn. Much loved granda of the late Isaac. Reposing at home 3A Kensington Park from 12.00 noon on Tuesday 22nd October. Patrick's remains will be brought to St Colmcille's Church, Ballyhackamore at 6.30pm on Wednesday 23rd October. Requiem Mass in St Colmcille's Church, Ballyhackamore at 12.00 noon on Thursday 24th October followed by committal in Roselawn Crematorium. Deeply regretted by his loving family circle. Family flowers only please, donations in lieu if so desired to St Vincent de Paul c/o O'Kanes Funeral Directors, 116-118 Donegall Street, Belfast, BT1 2GX or online at
